summary: ArcBest Corporation filed an 8-K (Item 1.02) reporting the termination of its Third Amended and Restated Receivables Loan Agreement with Toronto-Dominion Bank. The agreement, which provided up to a $50 million commitment (expandable to $150 million) and was secured by accounts receivable, was used to issue letters of credit for self-insured casualty claims. As of April 29, 2026, no letters of credit or borrowings were outstanding, and no termination penalties were paid. Letters of credit will now be issued under a separate credit agreement. This is a routine financing arrangement change with no special-situation implications.
